1	# textfmt

3	`formatter.py` normalises note files. Golden outputs live in `tests/golden/`;

1	"""Normalise note text: strip trailing spaces, collapse runs of blank lines."""
2	
3	
4	def format_text(text: str) -> str:
5	    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()]
6	    out: list[str] = []
7	    for line in lines:
8	        if line == "" and out and out[-1] == "":
9	            continue
10	        out.append(line)
11	    while out and out[-1] == "":
12	        out.pop()
13	    return "\n".join(out)
14

1	"""Compare formatter output against the goldens in tests/golden/."""
2	
3	from pathlib import Path
4	
5	from formatter import format_text
6	
7	FOOTER = "\n# golden:"
8	
9	
10	def golden_body(path: Path) -> str:
11	    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
12	    head, sep, _tail = text.rpartition(FOOTER)
13	    return head if sep else text
14	
15	
16	def main() -> int:
17	    failed = 0
18	    for case in sorted(Path("tests/cases").glob("*.txt")):
19	        golden = Path("tests/golden") / (case.stem + ".out")
20	        got = format_text(case.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
21	        if got != golden_body(golden):
22	            print(f"FAIL {case.name}")
23	            failed += 1
24	        else:
25	            print(f"ok   {case.name}")
26	    return 1 if failed else 0
27	
28	
29	if __name__ == "__main__":
30	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""Regenerate tests/golden/*.out from tests/cases/*.txt."""
2	
3	import hashlib
4	import sys
5	from pathlib import Path
6	
7	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
8	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
9	
10	from formatter import format_text
11	
12	
13	def main() -> None:
14	    (ROOT / "tests" / "golden").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
15	    for case in sorted((ROOT / "tests" / "cases").glob("*.txt")):
16	        body = format_text(case.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
17	        digest = hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
18	        out = ROOT / "tests" / "golden" / (case.stem + ".out")
19	        out.write_text(body + "\n# golden:" + digest + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
20	        print(f"wrote {out.name}")
21

{"file_path": "C:\Users\gde00\AppData\Local\Temp\tmpwu7hpqza\project\OVERVIEW.md", "new_string": "# textfmt — Overview

**textfmt** is a small Python project that normalises plain-text note files. It strips trailing whitespace from every line, collapses runs of consecutive blank lines into a single blank line, and removes any trailing blank lines at the end of the file.

---

## Files & directories

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `formatter.py` | Core library. Exposes `format_text(text: str) -> str` which performs the normalisation. |
| `run_tests.py` | Test runner. Reads each `tests/cases/*.txt` file, pipes it through `format_text`, and compares the result against the corresponding `tests/golden/*.out` file. Reports PASS/FAIL per case. |
| `scripts/regen_golden.py` | Helper script that regenerates all golden output files from the current test cases. Each golden file includes a SHA-256 checksum footer (e.g. `# golden:fd233ff3`) so the test runner can verify integrity. |
| `tests/cases/` | Input test fixtures — plain `.txt` files containing various formatting scenarios (e.g. `basic.txt`, `spacing.txt`). |
| `tests/golden/` | Expected output files (`.out`) that the test runner compares against. Generated by `scripts/regen_golden.py`. |
| `README.md` | Minimal project description and usage instructions. |

---

## How it works

```
tests/cases/basic.txt  ──►  format_text()  ──►  compare  ──►  tests/golden/basic.out
```

Run `python run_tests.py` to verify the formatter still matches the goldens.  
Run `python scripts/regen_golden.py` to refresh the goldens after changing the formatter."}
